source.author: lucan
source.text: Niger inficit horror Terga maris: longo per multa volumina tractu Aestuat unda minax, flatusque incerta futuri: Turbida testantur conceptos aequora ventos.
source.text_original: Niger inficit horror / Terga maris: longo per multa volumina tractu / Aestuat unda minax, flatusque incerta futuri: / Turbida testantur conceptos aequora ventos.
source.text_english: A black dread stains the sea’s back: with a long sweep through many coils the threatening wave boils, and the uncertain blasts of what is to come; the troubled waters attest the winds they have conceived.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_original: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, / strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_english: All the grove of the god groans with rapid wings; Ceres is laid low, and the black sea is stirred beneath the swift bird.
